checks.name: Instancing has bounded, finite transform and attribute data
Filaments emerge near the camera body and rise toward distant anchors
Segment transforms connect to the sampled curved filament without gaps
Raycast instance IDs map to valid, fully covered illustrative audit fixtures
Seeded variation is deterministic and keeps release order and radii bounded
Release remains bounded and monotonic, with a staggered body-to-anchor cascade
Dissolution particle fixtures remain finite, mapped, and bounded
Custom instance budgets preserve shape and fixture mapping
Drain rendering consumes the shared clock, palette, and global grade

limitations: CPU geometry and source checks do not establish actual GPU raycast targeting, shader appearance, input behavior, or the emotional quality of release/dawn.
Ordinary-scroll safety, deliberate gesture/keyboard parity, camera orientation, settled advancement, lifecycle cleanup, and Merge timing require browser evidence.
No GPU/device FPS or physical mobile acceptance is inferred.
